name: midi-message-filterer-and-device-proxy
description: MIDI Proxy to filter spammy CC messages

scripts.compile:mac-intel: deno compile -A --unstable-detect-cjs --include frontend/dist --target x86_64-apple-darwin --output build/midi-fixer-mac-intel backend/server.ts
scripts.compile:mac-m1: deno compile -A --unstable-detect-cjs --include frontend/dist --target aarch64-apple-darwin --output build/midi-fixer-mac-m1 backend/server.ts
scripts.compile:win: deno compile -A --unstable-detect-cjs --include frontend/dist --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --output build/midi-fixer-windows backend/server.ts
scripts.compile:linux: deno compile -A --unstable-detect-cjs --include frontend/dist --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --output build/midi-fixer-linux backend/server.ts
scripts.compile: pnpm run build && pnpm run compile:mac-intel && pnpm run compile:mac-m1 && pnpm run compile:win && pnpm run compile:linux
scripts.release: pnpm run compile && zip -rj build/midi-fixer-mac-intel.zip build/midi-fixer-mac-intel && zip -rj build/midi-fixer-mac-m1.zip build/midi-fixer-mac-m1 && zip -rj build/midi-fixer-windows.zip build/midi-fixer-windows.exe && zip -rj build/midi-fixer-linux.zip build/midi-fixer-linux
